links.outcome: Treatment recommendation accuracy and concordant interventions versus proprietary cloud comparator
links.effect: MedGemma-RAG identified 2.3 times more MDT-concordant interventions than the proprietary cloud comparator (p = 0.020), with no significant difference in overall accuracy.
links.quote: MedGemma-RAG identified 2.3 times more MDT-concordant interventions than a proprietary cloud comparator (p = 0.020), with no significant difference in overall accuracy.
